## Opponent Reads

**Player 2**: **LAG/maniac, extreme calling station postflop AS PFA.** Opens very wide (~50% PFR). **4-bets frequently — especially vs my 3-bets. P2 has specifically adjusted to my 3-betting frequency.** 3-bets extremely wide. **As PFA**: Calls down with virtually anything. C-bets most flops, BUT may check dry/paired boards. Turn: AIR → checks/folds (float profitable); REAL HANDS → continues aggressively (shoves with overpairs). Folds to turn raises even after double-barreling. **Facing donk-leads: calls one street then folds to continued pressure — CONFIRMED multiple times.** Fires big when opponent shows weakness — but if P2 checks after opponent shows weakness, P2 likely has air. **As 3-BET CALLER (OOP)**: More fit-or-fold than as PFA — folds to c-bets on boards where P2 whiffs. Folds to check-raise all-ins even in 3-bet pots. **Exploit**: Flat P2's opens more often with suited broadways/connectors IP. Reserve 3-bets for hands that handle 4-bets (QQ+/AKs to 5-bet; AQs/JJ to call). When P2 calls 3-bet, c-bet most flops. Value bet extremely thin as PFA. Float flop c-bets. Two-barrel bluffs effective. Raise turn bets as bluff.

**Player 3**: **Selectively aggressive, skilled — most dangerous opponent. PERSISTENT LOSER across many sessions — likely overadjusting or running bad.** Opens and 4-bets wider than premium (suited aces, medium pairs). **3-bets from blinds vs ALL position opens** — blind 3-bet range is wider than typical. Calls 3-bets with medium pairs (99). **Confirmed trapper with WIDE check-raise range** — check-raises overpairs on wet boards for protection (not always monsters). River checks can still be traps. **Folds dry/disconnected boards without connections. Triple-barrels with one-pair value hands.** Floating P3 is LOW EV — only continue with strong draws (9+ outs) or made hands. **On wet boards in 3-bet pots, P3 checks strong hands to set up check-raises.** **Exploit**: C-bet when P3 checks disconnected/dry boards. Don't value-bet thin on river. Call P3's 3-bets IP with strong suited hands — P3 gives up without connection. On wet boards, be prepared to call check-raises with overpairs.

**Player 4**: **Wide VPIP (~50%), passive preflop, aggressive postflop.** Calls 3-bets with suited junk. Limp-reraise = strong. Shoves AA. EXTREMELY sticky — calls river with bottom pair, 9-high. Check-raises turn with made hands. **3-bets are strong (JJ+/AQ+) but folds to 4-bets.** As single-raiser PFA: C-bets flop then gives up on turn — FLOATABLE. Do NOT float vs P4's 3-bets. **Exploit**: 3-bet for VALUE only. Value bet extremely wide (#1 value target). NEVER bluff. Check strong hands to induce. Respect check-raises/donk-bets/limp-reraises/3-bets.

**Player 5**: **Tight (~10-15% VPIP), but STICKIER than typical nit with pocket pairs.** Opens hands like A8s in position. Cold-calls 3-bets with medium pairs. **Will call down with underpairs** — called all-in with 99 on T-high board. NOT a pure fold-to-pressure nit; calling station with pairs. **As PFA**: C-bets flop then shuts down without connection. Single donk-bet → folds to raises/turn barrels. **Call flop → raise turn = monster.** **Exploit**: Two-barrel bluff donk-bets. Call flop c-bets wider — P5 gives up on turn. Do NOT multi-barrel bluff when P5 has shown pair commitment.

**Player 6**: **Station/spewy tendencies but capable of winning sessions — may be underestimated.** Opens wide. **4-bet shoves are NUTTED (AA confirmed) — ALWAYS FOLD without QQ+.** As PFA: C-bets flop then folds to turn donk-leads. Folds big pairs on ace-high boards. **Exploit**: Value bet extremely wide postflop. Bluff ace-high boards as PFA. Isolate but fold to 4-bet aggression.

**Player 7**: **Wide opener, passive preflop, AGGRESSIVE postflop.** Folds to 3-bets after cold-calling opens. Donk-leads and triple-barrels with strength. Raises flop with top pair on paired boards. Sticky as caller — calls c-bets with J-high on paired boards. **Exploit**: Value bet relentlessly and size up. Don't bluff once they've shown aggression. 3-bet to isolate when P7 cold-calls.

## Core Strategy

1. **VPIP target: 20-25%.** Tight image = fold equity = primary profit. Proven over 11 sessions.
2. **SUITED is king**: Suited broadways and suited connectors are highest-EV aggression hands. Offsuit broadways only AJo+ from CO/BTN. K-x suited, A-x suited profitable steals.
3. **Station exploit (P2, P4, P5 w/pairs, P6, P7)**: Value bet wide, NEVER bluff postflop, isolate limps.
4. **P2 preflop REVISED**: Flat P2's opens with suited broadways/connectors IP. Reserve 3-bets for QQ+/AKs (5-bet) and AQs/JJ (call 4-bet). Mix occasional light 3-bets to stay unpredictable. When P2 calls 3-bet, c-bet most boards.
5. **P4 floating**: ONLY float vs single raise. RESPECT P4's 3-bets.
6. **P5**: Two-barrel bluff donk-bets. Call flop c-bets wider. Do NOT multi-barrel when P5 shows pair commitment.
7. **P6**: Isolate preflop, FOLD to 4-bet shoves. Value bet wide postflop.
8. **P3 (skilled)**: Call 3-bets IP with strong suited hands. Avoid thin river value. DO NOT float without 9+ clean outs. Expect wet-board check-raises. Size c-bets to allow calling with overpairs.
9. **Threat hierarchy**: P3 (skilled) > P4 (steady) > P7 (aggressive) > P2 (LAG volume) > P5 (sticky with pairs) > P6 (spewy).
10. **SMALL/MEDIUM PAIRS (22-88)**: Set-mine cheaply only. Check-fold on miss. Do NOT overcommit.
11. **Win mechanism**: Profits come from preflop/flop aggression with fold equity, NOT showdowns. Big pots come from premium hands vs stations. Lean into both.
